subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should crash-loop safe mode continue requiring explicit `channels.start` recovery after `secrets.reload`, or should reload transactionally restart accounts that were already running?
rationale: The linked bug only requires control-plane startup recovery, while the branch changes an existing documented channel lifecycle and message-delivery contract; tests cannot determine which operator behavior maintainers intend.

options.title: Keep startup-only recovery
options.body: Retain the source/assignment projection fix while leaving automatic channel restarts suppressed and requiring explicit operator recovery after inspection.

options.title: Adopt transactional restarts
options.body: Approve automatic restart of previously running accounts, with exact-head supervised proof for stopped accounts, multiple accounts, timeouts, rollback, and retry behavior.

options.title: Select the competing PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 as the canonical implementation after confirming its current head and proof satisfy the intended narrow contract.

recommendation.title: Keep startup-only recovery
recommendation.body: Retain the source/assignment projection fix while leaving automatic channel restarts suppressed and requiring explicit operator recovery after inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the crash-loop safe-mode behavior and documented its restart-suppression boundary.
